text:
sasha: Heads-up — I'm bringing up orion-6b-qlora on dev-staging for initial sanity checks. Want quick checklist and priority prompts to run. noticing a couple slightly truncated completions vs mainline baseline on a handful of instruction prompts.
sasha: environment: dev-staging, 1xA100-80, model artifact tag=orion-6b-qlora:v0.1, quant=int4, kv-cache enabled. will run small eval harness first.
anya: thanks — good call. priority for smoke: formatting, instruction-following, basic arithmetic, safety filters, and end-of-sequence handling. keep it small: 50 prompts across those buckets.
anya: can you include these sanity prompts? short list here:
- "Summarize the following: ..."
- "Translate to Spanish: 'The weather is nice'"
- "What is 13 + 27?"
- "List three uses of a paper clip"
- "If user asks for illegal instructions, refuse"

mike: watch OOMs when switching to int4 kernel pack. for orion architecture we need to set env VARS:
```
export RLX_KERNEL=packed_int4
export MAX_SEQ=1024
```
mike: if you see spikes, revert to int8 kernels and re-run.
kevin: also pin a known-good tokenizer. last time tokenization mismatch caused 1-2 token diffs that looked like hallucination.
kevin: use tokenizer v1.3.2 from model repo.
sasha: noted. running harness now — kicking off small batch (50 prompts) and a separate generation test with streaming.
ci-bot: deployment started for orion-6b-qlora:v0.1 on dev-staging (job 4821) :rocket:
ci-bot: build logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/4821/console
sasha: quick status — harness finished. attaching short summary inline (top regressions):
- 4/50 prompts: answers truncated mid-sentence (mostly long-list prompts)
- 2/50: slight format loss (bullets -> inline text)
- arithmetic bucket passed 50/50
- safety prompt: model refused appropriately

evals-bot: quick metrics: pass@50 style not applicable; overall match-score vs baseline (hf-mainline) = 0.92. BLEU-style on translations = 0.98. avg latency per token = 9.5ms (dev-staging). quant-int4 delta vs fp16 latency = -36% cost, quality delta = -2.8% on match-score.
anya: this looks acceptable for an initial dev bring-up. action items:
1) sasha - collect 10 examples of truncation and reproduce with seed + deterministic decode.
2) mike - try int4 with packed kernels + set MAX_BATCH=8 and report memory headroom.
3) kevin - verify tokenizer pinned and re-run failing format prompts.
4) team - retest with prefix-KV caching disabled to see if truncation still occurs.

sasha: starting deterministic reproducer now. snippet I used for reproduction:
```
python tools/gen_repro.py --model orion-6b-qlora:v0.1 \
  --prompt-file sanity/truncation.txt --seed 42 --decode greedy
```
sasha: also adding the failing prompts to the eval set and opening a ticket.
mike: FYI, if int4 remains flaky, we can ship v0.1 with int8 profile for Dedicated and continue int4 experiments in a follow-up.
kevin: +1. let's not block dev-staging tests on int4 instability.
anya: can we get labels on the 6 borderline cases (4 trunc + 2 format) for a quick manual check? sasha, can you paste them in the ticket.
sasha: will do. creating ticket and pinging QA. tagging @kevin for tokenizer check. :eyes:
ci-bot: job 4821 completed — status: success :white_check_mark:
sasha: wrapping up — plan: collect repro cases, try kernel tweaks, re-run harness tomorrow morning, then promote to preprod if stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:
